notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Scaffold a shared safe-settings admin repository for an organization.
evals.expected_output: The skill selects the deployment path, pins the safe-settings version, validates the matching schema, diffs templates, and reports setup checks.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Configure squash-only merging and a PR ruleset for this one repository.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines org-wide safe-settings scaffolding for a single repository and redirects the request to gh-bootstrap.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Run the first full-sync now; we have not inventoried labels or protected the admin repo yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill warns that a full-sync without a label inventory can delete existing labels and that an unprotected admin repo is a privilege-escalation risk, then asks before running the sync.
